abEdit.name: A/B week reset
abEdit.notice: Choose a week and its letter, then preview the result. The reset is kept for this school on this device; a source does not prove that the school sent it.
abEdit.rules: The reset starts in the selected week. Letters alternate until the next reset, skipping holiday weeks. Exam weeks keep their letter. Recorded sessions are never rewritten.

lunarEdit.notice: After the sighting is announced, choose the first holiday day and give the announcement's source. Its duration stays the same. This is your local confirmation, not verification by an authority.
lunarEdit.local: Confirmed by you on this device. The bundled reference is unchanged. Cancel this entry to withdraw your confirmation.
lunarEdit.stale: The entry behind this confirmation changed. Its old dates no longer apply; review the entry again or withdraw the old confirmation.

ramadan.open: Confirm the first day of Ramadan
ramadan.day: First day of Ramadan in the announcement
ramadan.notice: After the sighting is announced, choose the first day of Ramadan and give the announcement's source. Ramadan ends on the eve of Eid al-Fitr, as the calendar has it. This is your local confirmation, not verification by an authority.

edit.title: Entry name
edit.wholeDay: Choose the whole day, morning or afternoon. The same part applies on every date in the range.
edit.cancelNotice: This removes the entry's effect from the calendar. Earlier versions stay in history and recorded sessions are not erased.
edit.readOnly: This entry cannot be edited here. Bundled dates and updates have their own process.
edit.invalid: Check the name, source and dates. The range must be within the school year, with the end on or after the start.
edit.failed: Not all changes were saved. Your draft is still here; please try again.
edit.changed: The data changed after the preview. Preview it again before saving.
edit.private: A training day or duty is private to you. Do not put pupil information in the name or source.
edit.scopeFixed: An entry keeps its school or zone and layer. To change those, cancel it and add another.
edit.capacity: {{class}} · before {{day}} ({{basis}}): available sessions {{before}} → {{after}}; the plan needs {{needs}}.
edit.termEnd: term end, not an announced exam date
edit.needZone: Set the school's wilaya in Settings first.

status.rotation: No session for this group today

title: Calendar
noSchool: Add your school in Settings to see its calendar.
empty: No entries this month match your selection.
missing: This entry is not in the selected school's calendar.

origin.bundled: From the calendar bundled with the app. The source above explains where the date came from; it does not mean that authority sent it through the app.
origin.local: Kept on this device. The source is what was recorded when it was added, not proof of the sender's identity.

private: This entry is in your private layer and is not included when lesson records are shared.
noLetter: No letter, outside the teaching weeks
ramadan: Ramadan bell times apply. A shortened session still counts as one session.

ramadanHours.title: Session length in Ramadan, by level
ramadanHours.lengthFrom: Each session keeps its slot and its start time, and lasts {{minutes}} minutes instead of {{usual}}.
ramadanHours.length: Each session keeps its slot and its start time, and lasts {{minutes}} minutes.
ramadanHours.none: Not announced yet: sessions keep their usual length.

effect.closure: Closure: calendar losses are counted separately.
effect.exam: Exams replace sessions and pause the plan.
effect.marker: A calendar event that does not cancel sessions.
effect.week-a: Set week A from the week this entry starts in.
effect.week-b: Set week B from the week this entry starts in.
effect.adds-sessions: A day that adds sessions from its chosen timetable.
effect.rotating-groups: Half the class each day; plan progress counts after both groups have covered the item.

groups.missingRoster: Some pupils need a group assignment. Open the calendar, edit this class’s rotation and confirm the split before saving roll call.
groups.noClass: Add the class in Settings first.
groups.notice: Half the class attends each day, in the usual slots. This local setting records your source; it does not authenticate a school notice.
groups.split: Split the class into two groups
groups.splitNotice: Review the proposed list, move pupils as needed, then confirm. Changes apply from today and do not change saved roll-call lists.
groups.splitReady: Groups confirmed. You can now preview the rotation.
groups.invalid: Check both groups and the complete list. Existing group identities are kept.
groups.rules: Rotation follows working days and the A/B week. An item is complete for the class only after both groups have covered it. The whole class resumes after the period. Recorded sessions and roll calls stay unchanged.
groups.capacity: {{subject}} · {{queue}} — physical sessions: {{physical}} · plan sessions they equal: {{effective}} · repeats: {{repeated}}, counted as calendar cost, not delay.
groups.off: No session for this group today
groups.tdCapacity: TD before {{day}} — sessions available: {{gives}} · items left: {{items}}. No extra buffers are invented.

receive.scanHint: Point the camera at the code on paper or another phone. Images are not saved or sent.
receive.notice: Receive a closure notice from your school or a colleague, without a network. Review its source and school before adding it; the sender’s identity is not authenticated.
receive.school: School in the file: {{name}} · zone {{zone}} · code {{code}}
receive.zone: The closure covers your schools in zone {{zone}}.
receive.scopeHint: Matching a name and zone does not prove who sent it. If both sides have a school code, it must match. Check the levels and dates too.
receive.acknowledge: I reviewed the notice and it applies to the selected school or zone.
receive.duplicate: This entry is already in the calendar. It will not be added again.
receive.received: This notice was received and added after your review. The sender and source are claims from the file, not official authentication. You can cancel it; to change it, add a new local entry.
receive.newerMinor: The file uses a newer compatible version. Unknown details were left out.
receive.privacy: The camera opens only for scanning and closes when you leave. Images stay in memory and are not saved or sent. Opening a file grants no general access to your files.

problems.invalid: This is not a valid closure notice in this format. Nothing was added.
problems.version: This file format is newer than the app supports. Update the app first.
problems.country: This notice is for another country. Nothing was added.
problems.year: This notice is for another school year. Nothing was added.
problems.scope: The school, zone or levels do not match. Check the notice and the selected school.
problems.conflict: An entry with the same ID has different content. Review it in the calendar; nothing will be replaced automatically.
problems.acknowledge: Review the notice and confirm that it applies to the selected school or zone first.
problems.input: The file or code could not be read. Try again or use a file instead of the camera.

update.lead: A signed calendar, without a network
update.hint: A file from a colleague or the school, by Bluetooth or a USB key. It is opened on its own, and its signature is checked before anything else.
update.signer: Signed by: {{holder}}. Nothing in the file has changed since it was signed.
update.none: Nothing in it concerns my schools and classes.
update.others_one: It also holds {{count}} entry that does not concern me, not shown.
update.others_other: It also holds {{count}} entries that do not concern me, not shown.
update.held: This update is already in the calendar, so nothing changes.
update.older: The calendar holds a later release than this one, so it is not applied.

checks.format: An update file in Minhajna's format
checks.key: Names a key the app trusts
checks.keyOf: Names the key of {{holder}}, with its published fingerprint
checks.signature: The signature matches what is in the file
checks.content: A calendar update for this year and country

update.unchangedBody: None of it was applied: the calendar and my classes are as they were.
update.whatNowBody: Ask whoever sent it for the file again, or scan its code straight from their phone.
update.reportHint: Help says what to send: the file's name and why it was refused, not its content.
update.everyUpdate: Every update is checked like this before it is applied: if it was changed after signing, it shows here and is not applied.

invalid.title: Not an update file in Minhajna's format, so it was not applied
invalid.body: It may be another file, or an incomplete copy.

version.title: This file's format is newer than the app reads, so it was not applied
version.body: Update the app, then open the file again.

update-version.title: This file's format is newer than the app reads, so it was not applied
update-version.body: Update the app, then open the file again.

unknown-key.title: No key the app trusts signed it, so it was not applied
unknown-key.body: The key may be newer than this app: update the app, or ask for the file from its source.

signature.title: This file changed after it was signed, so it was not applied
signature.body: The signature does not match what is in the file: something in it changed after it was signed. It may be an incomplete copy, or it was edited.

payload.title: What the file holds cannot be read, so it was not applied
payload.body: The signature is valid, but its content does not follow the format. Update the app, or report it.

kind.title: This update is not for the calendar, so it was not applied
kind.body: Signed plans come in a later version of the app.

country.title: This update is for another country, so it was not applied
country.body: It does not concern the calendar in the app.

year.title: This update is for another school year, so it was not applied
year.body: It does not concern the calendar in the app.

content.title: What the update holds cannot be read, so it was not applied
content.body: The signature is valid, but its content does not follow the calendar format. Update the app, or report it.

changed.title: What changed in the calendar
changed.bundled: This release is now in the calendar bundled with the app, so it changes nothing any more.
changed.sessions: What still changes in your sessions from today
changed.recorded: Recorded sessions do not change. If something changes again, another update arrives, and what it changed shows on its own page.

today.title: A calendar update, received today
today.taken_one: It takes {{count}} of your sessions, counted under “calendar”, not as delay.
today.taken_other: It takes {{count}} of your sessions, counted under “calendar”, not as delay.
today.none: It takes none of your sessions and gives none back.

entry.origin: From calendar update {{release}}, published {{day}}, signed by {{holder}}. The source above says where the date came from.

update.hoursDropped: It no longer carries the Ramadan session lengths: they go back to the provisional lengths in the bell times, or to the usual times where there are none.
